note: Held-out combined multiclass Brier as each shipped component is added to the bare Dixon-Coles goal model, ending at the production model. delta is the step-to-step change. bought records whether the decomposition credited the gain to resolution (sharper separation between outcomes) or reliability (calibration). A uniform 1/3-1/3-1/3 guess scores 0.667. Numbers from the README methodology. Caveat: the value-prior weights were tuned on 2006-2018, so four of the five held-out tournaments overlap that window in the first step; only 2022 is fully out of sample there (0.6123 to 0.5907).

valuePrior.note: The one data edge that shipped, the squad market-value prior, with its cleanest out-of-sample numbers. oos2022 is the 2022 leg alone, fully out of sample. fiveTourney pools all five held-out tournaments, of which four overlap the 2006-2018 tuning window, so it always carries that tag. lotoFixed vs lotoRetuned is the overfitting check: re-tuning the weights per fold does slightly worse than the fixed weights. proxyBrier vs realSquadBrier swaps published squads in for the value proxy and finds nothing.

fiveTourney.tag: all five, four overlap the tuning window

engines.note: The README head-to-head of the raw goal engines on the same 320 held-out matches, all multiclass Brier. The four sit within 0.003 of each other; the shipped model at 0.5441 is pulled clear only by the gated calibration chain, measured from its own 0.5717 Dixon-Coles baseline. The engine table's 0.574 and the ablation baseline 0.5717 are separately-labelled configurations, not one comparison.
